negative_findings.description: https://www.a-tvp.si/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain server-side fetch, so no ATVP page structure could be confirmed by direct retrieval in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Site is almost certainly live (multiple current deep links appear in search results); 403 indicates bot defence, not a dead host. All ATVP entries recorded as unverified with blocked=true.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ATVP is a critical cell source. Collection pipeline must use a headless browser or realistic headers, otherwise the securities supervisor will silently drop out of monitoring.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated standing 'javna posvetovanja' index page was confirmed for ATVP or UPPD; consultations appear to be announced as individual news items rather than in a structured consultation register.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATVP consultations found only as /novica/ items (e.g. 'Javni posvet o osnutkih dokumentov ESMA'). AZN by contrast has a 'Predpisi v pripravi' subsection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline tracking for ATVP/UPPD must rely on news-feed keyword monitoring, which is noisier and more fragile than a structured consultation index.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or open API endpoint was confirmed for a-tvp.si, a-zn.si, ip-rs.si or the UPPD gov.si pages during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only HTML section pages were observed; feed discovery was not performed at HTML-source level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should assume HTML diffing plus PDF mirroring; a follow-up pass should check /rss, /feed and gov.si content APIs before building scrapers.

negative_findings.description: The exact URL of Slovenia's MONEYVAL 6th-round mutual evaluation report was not located; only the fact of its publication (via the UPPD site) and the MONEYVAL landing page are recorded.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded at issuer-site level with confidence 0.7 rather than inventing a document URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The evaluation report and its follow-up timetable are the single best forward indicator of Slovenian AML tightening; the precise link should be resolved in a targeted pass.

negative_findings.description: English-language versions of ATVP, AZN and UPPD content were not confirmed in this pass; all confirmed material is Slovenian.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search seeds in English returned mostly Slovenian-language official pages; no separate /en supervisory guidance trees verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream collection and NLP must be Slovenian-capable; assuming English mirrors exist would create silent coverage loss.

coverage_gaps.description: Systematic enforcement/sanctions publication points were only partially identified (AZN 'razkritje ukrepov nadzora'); equivalent publication points for ATVP (odločbe, javne objave sankcij), UPPD inspections, and IP-RS fines were not confirmed at URL level.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted pass per supervisor to locate the enforcement-publication path and its update cadence.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level originators (ESMA, EIOPA, EBA, EDPB, AMLA) are the upstream authors of much of what this cell republishes, but were treated as out-of-cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm another cell covers ESMA/EIOPA/EDPB/AMLA; otherwise the earliest lead time on obligations is lost.

coverage_gaps.description: ZDIJZ (freedom-of-information) as an active acquisition channel for non-published supervisory material was identified conceptually but not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use AZN/ATVP 'katalog informacij javnega značaja' plus IP-RS FOI decisions to scope what is realistically obtainable, then decide whether requests are in scope for this programme.

brief: Slovenia's non-NCB supervisory layer for banks and PSPs is concentrated in four bodies with markedly different publishing hygiene: UPPD (AML/CFT, on gov.si, clean and current — Aug 2026 ZPPDFT amendment and MONEYVAL 6th-round report both visible), IP-RS (a large, searchable opinions corpus with a dense bank/payments cluster, split across GDPR/ZVOP-1/ZVOP-2 vintages that must be validity-tagged), AZN (well-structured, with an explicit 'Predpisi v pripravi' consultation subsection and AML enforcement disclosures relevant to bancassurance), and ATVP (materially important for MiFID-scope bank activity but bot-defended — a plain fetch of the domain returned 403, so all ATVP entries are unverified hypotheses, not dead links). Binding force and hard deadlines converge on two cross-cutting publication points that should anchor the pipeline: Uradni list RS, where 'sklepi o uporabi smernic' acquire legal effect, and the eUprava/E-demokracija predlogi-predpisov portal, which carries dated 30–60 day consultation windows on draft acts. The main structural weakness is that ATVP and UPPD announce consultations as ordinary news items rather than in a structured register, so deadline tracking for those two will require keyword monitoring of news feeds plus PDF mirroring; enforcement-publication paths per supervisor remain the largest unmapped document type.
